title: flask-todolist — a small application carrying a large, machine-checked governance apparatus
description:
A Flask to-do application used as the substrate for an experiment in machine-checked project governance.

Every rule the project declares is indexed in a registry (gates.yaml) verified in both directions; each rule must carry evidence that it once failed for a real defect (proved_by); the portable subset is generated into an agent skill and an overlay applicable to other projects; and the effect on generated code is measured against controlled arms. 26 recorded audit rounds, each asking a question the previous round could not, are part of the artefact.

Documentation and the decision records are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the software is AGPL-3.0-or-later.
